title: 第1章第2章 混沌万物鼎
slug: 大婚之日我阉了未婚妻的白月光
content_zh:
大夏，龙都。
镇北王公爵府。
“一拜天地……”
一个温文尔雅的青年司仪刚开口，立刻被旁边一个身披凤冠霞帔女人，冷若冰霜又孤傲的语气打断！
“好了！这天地就不用拜了！”
在场的宾客们全都愣住！
忍不住窃窃私语起来：“大婚之日，天地都不拜？这叶凡都忍得住啊！”
“嘿嘿！不愧是大夏第一废物纨绔啊！这小子把长公主娶回去后，有他受的了！”
“哈哈哈！据说今天的司仪，也就是状元郎和长公主的关系不清不楚呢……”
“我还听说，两人早已私定终生……这也叶凡，头上帽子都发绿了吧？还在哪儿发呆呢！”
嗡——！
听着周围的议论，叶凡的脑子一嗡，迷茫的睁开眼睛！
“这是哪儿？”
下一秒。
叶凡的身体一颤，一下子反应过来！
“公爵府？大夏皇朝？”
“她是……李幽若？”
“怎么可能！”
叶凡惊讶的看着眼前的红衣女人！
低头一看，自己居然也身穿新郎官的礼袍！

“我这是……又重生回来了？前世的一切……难道不是梦吗？”
叶凡是华夏龙组一名特种兵王！
执行国宝‘九州鼎’护送任务的时候，敌人引爆炸弹，他带着国宝九州鼎葬身火海！
在华夏的时候，叶凡就经常做一个梦！
梦里他是一个高武世界，夏开国战神叶峥嵘之子，公爵府小公爷！
叶峥嵘在他母亲去世后，又娶了九房妻子！生了十个国色倾城的姐姐！
梦里的叶凡，虽然身份高贵，却极其纨绔！
十年前，父亲战死北境沙场！尸骨无存！
“我本来无心朝堂，只想在父亲的功勋下当一辈子逍遥小公爷！”
“我从小就喜欢大夏长公主李幽若，但李幽若却根本不喜欢我，而是喜欢一个落魄书生……一年前，书生高中状元，成为宰相王国忠的学生！”
“我和李幽若大婚当日，不拜堂！不行礼！当着我的面，把秦风接进公爵府！”
叶凡自嘲的笑着：“因为我太喜欢李幽若，任由秦风掌控公爵府的一切！”
“李幽若帮秦风把我灌醉，利用镇北王印，伪造一封造反密信，导致八姐被褫夺八十万兵权，八姐也被皇帝赐死！”
“八十万大军啊！！！你不会造反吗？”
“一手王炸！居然玩成这个鬼样子？叶凡啊叶凡，你他妈是傻逼吗？”叶凡都忍不住吐槽梦里的自己，真的太傻逼了。
如果这一场梦，他能再做一次！
肯定不会再让九个姨母被充军，自己惨死街头，被野狗分尸的下场！
“王爷！”
听到‘造反’二字，参加婚礼现场的众人，全都吓得瞠目结舌！
就连公爵府的大管家徐福，也一脸惊恐：“王爷……您……您刚才说什么？造反……”

叶凡冰冷的看着徐福。
就是此人，勾结秦风，毁掉了他的一切。
“什么造反？徐福，你听错了吧！”
叶凡摇头，环顾四周暴喝一声：“王大年！你给我滚出来！”
content_en:
Daxia, Longdu.
Zhenbei Prince's Palace.
"Worship the heaven and the earth..."
As soon as a gentle and elegant young emcee opened his mouth, he was immediately interrupted by the cold and aloof tone of a woman wearing a phoenix crown and a robe next to him!
"Okay! No need to worship this heaven and earth!"
All the guests present were stunned!
I couldn't help but whisper: "On your wedding day, heaven and earth won't bow to you? Even Mark Ye can bear it!"
"Hehe! He deserves to be the biggest loser in Great Xia! After this boy married the eldest princess, he has suffered a lot!"
"Hahaha! It is said that today's master of ceremonies, that is, the relationship between the number one scholar and the eldest princess is not clear..."
"I also heard that the two of them have been privately engaged for life... This is Ye Fan, the hat on his head is turning green, right? Are you still in a daze!"
Buzz—!
Listening to the discussions around him, Ye Fan's mind buzzed and he opened his eyes in confusion!
"Where is this?"
The next second.
Ye Fan's body trembled and he reacted immediately!
"Duke's Mansion? Daxia Dynasty?"
"She is... Li Youruo?"
"How is that possible!"
Ye Fan looked at the woman in red in surprise!
When he looked down, he saw that he was actually wearing the groom's official robe!
"Am I...reborn again? Everything in my previous life...isn't it a dream?"
Ye Fan is a special forces king of the Chinese Dragon Group!
While performing the mission of escorting the national treasure "Kyushu Ding", the enemy detonated a bomb, and he was buried in the sea of ​​​​fire with the national treasure "Kyushu Ding"!
When he was in China, Ye Fan often had a dream!
In the dream, he was in a world of high martial arts, the son of Ye Zhengrong, the God of War of Xia Kaiguo, and the young prince of the Duke's Palace!
After his mother passed away, Ye Zhengrong married another nine-bedroom wife! I gave birth to ten beautiful sisters!
Ye Fan in the dream, although he has a noble status, is extremely dandy!
Ten years ago, my father died on the battlefield in the north! No bones left!
"I had no intention of going to court, I just wanted to be a happy young father-in-law for the rest of my life thanks to my father's merits!"
"I have liked Li Youruo, the eldest princess of Daxia, since I was a child, but Li Youruo doesn't like me at all, but likes a down-and-out scholar... A year ago, the scholar was the top scholar in high school and became the student of Prime Minister Wang Guozhong!"
"On the wedding day of Li Youruo and I, we will not bow to the court! We will not be polite! In front of me, take Qin Feng into the Duke's Mansion!"
Ye Fan smiled self-deprecatingly: "Because I like Li Youruo so much that I let Qin Feng control everything in the Duke's Palace!"
"Li Youruo helped Qin Feng get me drunk, and used the Zhenbei King's Seal to forge a secret letter of rebellion. As a result, the Eighth Sister was deprived of 800,000 military rights, and the Eighth Sister was also sentenced to death by the emperor!"
"An army of 800,000 people!!! Aren't you going to rebel?"
"One-handed king! You actually acted like this? Ye Fan, Ye Fan, are you a fucking idiot?" Ye Fan couldn't help complaining about himself in the dream, he was really such an idiot.
If only he could have this dream again!
I will definitely not let my nine aunts be exiled to the army, and I will die miserably on the street, and be torn apart by wild dogs!
"Your Majesty!"
When they heard the word 'rebellion', everyone attending the wedding was shocked and dumbfounded!
Even Xu Fu, the chief steward of the Duke's Palace, looked horrified: "Your Highness... you... what did you just say? Rebellion..."
Ye Fan looked at Xu Fu coldly.
It was this person who colluded with Qin Feng and ruined everything for him.
"What rebellion? Xu Fu, did you hear it wrong?"
Ye Fan shook his head, looked around and shouted: "Wang Danian! Get out of here!"
